meta.name: minshot
meta.description: Minshot Chinese landing — quiet native-macOS utility aesthetic: cool near-white ground, modest system typography, blue pill download CTA, one large real product screenshot, plain feature rows and stacked pricing panels. Measured DOM/computed CSS and full-page screenshots at 1280px and 390px viewport widths on 2026-09-07. Qualitative descriptions are interpretation; unobserved states remain explicitly unknown.

color.palette_type: cool neutral base with one blue action accent

accent.role: download CTA and feature icons; CTA gradient starts at #0a84ff

neutral.usage: Measured Radix gray tokens; supporting text and soft button labels use rgba(0,7,20,0.624), soft buttons rgba(0,0,51,0.06).

semantic.success: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
semantic.warning: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
semantic.error: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
semantic.info: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page

surface.elevated: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page

color.contrast_strategy: Dark text on near-white; blue concentrates attention on download actions. Muted alpha text supplies secondary hierarchy; this is an observed palette, not a contrast audit.

body.line_height: 24px for size-3 text; inherited theme line-height 22.5px

font_families.heading: system-ui, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
font_families.body: system-ui, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
font_families.mono: not used in visible page content

typography.font_style_notes: Chinese locale overrides .font-heading with system sans, normal tracking and weight 500. The shared CSS declares new-spirit/Georgia serif for other locales and body loads Inter, but neither is the effective Chinese content font. Do not import the English serif identity into this profile.

spacing.content_density: spacious sections, compact readable feature rows
spacing.section_rhythm: 64px main section gap; 40px between hero copy/CTA group and screenshot; 16px within hero copy; 24px heading-to-list gap and pricing panel padding; 12px feature row gaps; 8px pricing list gaps; 16px between pricing panels; navigation padding 48px top/16px bottom

layout.grid_system: centered width-limited container with left-aligned vertical flex content
layout.columns: one column for hero, features and both pricing cards on desktop and mobile
layout.gutter: 24px mobile page inset; feature icon-to-text 12px, pricing check-to-text 8px
layout.breakpoints: Observed 1280px and 390px widths; mobile content 342px, no horizontal overflow at 390px. No column-switch breakpoint observed; keep fluid width with 880px cap.
layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned copy, buttons and lists; brand left and links right in the top navigation

shape.border_usage: no visible heavy borders; image/icon shadow contains a subtle outline
shape.divider_style: whitespace between sections; small dot separators in footer links

elevation.shadow_style: restrained soft layered shadows on app icon, screenshot and primary download button

levels.low: none on pricing cards and soft buttons

elevation.depth_cues: soft CTA highlight, faint tinted cards and real macOS window depth inside the static screenshot

iconography.style: thin outlined SVG, round caps and joins; blue feature icons and checks
iconography.size_scale: 20px feature icons; 16px download icon; 28px raster app icon
iconography.preferred_set: inline SVG observed; package identity unverified — reuse the target project icon set

motion.easing: not applicable: inspected elements have 0s transition duration
motion.entrance_pattern: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
motion.exit_pattern: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
motion.philosophy: static and immediate; CSS hover gradient change, no ambient animation observed

components.button_style: 40px-high pill, 15px/500 label, 16px horizontal padding and 12px icon gap. Primary gradient #0a84ff → #0076ff with white text; hover #1a8dff → #0a84ff. Secondary soft gray pill. Navigation soft button is 32px high, 14px label, 12px horizontal padding.
components.input_style: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
components.card_style: full-width stacked pricing panels, 12px radius, 24px padding, very faint neutral tint; no raised bento tiles
components.navigation_pattern: non-sticky top row: 28px app icon plus wordmark left, two plain text links and a soft follow button right; same visible navigation at 390px
components.modal_style: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
components.list_style: single-column icon + medium-weight feature name + muted explanation; pricing uses compact checkmark rows
components.component_notes: Sequence: navigation → modest left-aligned hero and download CTA → 16:9 real screenshot → eight feature rows → two stacked pricing plans → quiet footer. Screenshot source is /hero.webp, displayed at 880×495px on desktop; it is not a live editor or a page background.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a small native Mac utility presented as a clear product note

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle CTA gradient and native app icon; product screenshot carries the visual richness
visual_language.whitespace_usage: wide outer margins with generous vertical pauses
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large screenshot anchors a narrow column; small blue actions punctuate neutral text
visual_language.focal_strategy: real product proof followed by scannable capabilities and clear pricing
visual_language.contrast_level: strong primary text; gentle surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: no page texture; screenshot contains its own background and window materials

composition.hierarchy_method: spacing, modest type size/weight steps and selective blue action emphasis
composition.grouping_strategy: proximity for features, faint panels for plans
composition.negative_space_role: separates decisions without extra borders or decorative blocks

imagery.photo_treatment: actual product screenshot, no stock photography observed
imagery.illustration_style: small native app icon; no illustration system observed
imagery.graphic_elements: blue outline icons, checkmarks and pill actions

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: download gradient brightens via CSS :hover; no transform in its custom rule
interaction_feel.loading_style: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: plain, friendly and specific about what the tool does
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: conversational Chinese with familiar macOS terminology
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short verb plus destination or outcome; download is the dominant action
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: not observed on the inspected Chinese landing page

overview.fallback_strategy: static content already carries the design; reduced-motion behavior was not separately verified

background_effects.description: flat #fcfcfd page; no animated or gradient background observed

image_effects.description: static /hero.webp with a rounded clipping wrapper; rich gradients and glass-like app UI are baked into the image

glassmorphism_neumorphism.style: none on the webpage; native material appearance exists inside the screenshot only

visual_effects.composite_notes: Inspected DOM contains zero canvas elements and zero SVG animate/animateTransform elements; document.getAnimations() returned zero. No particles, 3D scenes, shaders, cursor trails or scroll effects observed in desktop/mobile inspection. These are observations, not proof that every unused bundle lacks such code. The download gradient, inset highlight and layered shadow are CSS; never recreate the baked-in screenshot materials with WebGL. Unknown states and absent semantic tokens must come from the destination design system, not invented Minshot values.
